channel.description: Target channel to move the conversation to (sms or imessage).

recipient.description: Recipient address on the new channel (E.164). Required for sms/imessage.

use_case_id.title: Use Case Id
use_case_id.description: Channel-manager use case for the new channel (resolves the sender). Required for sms/imessage.

reason.description: Why the conversation is being moved (e.g. escalation, customer_request).

dispatch_opener.title: Dispatch Opener
dispatch_opener.description: If true, immediately drive one agent turn on the new channel (e.g. 'I'll text you now').

instruction.description: Optional context steering the opener when dispatch_opener=true.

ChannelKind.title: ChannelKind
ChannelKind.description:
HSM execution channel type.

Determines how the HSM engine communicates with end users.
Each kind maps to one or more providers.
